title: Typed [[refs]] manifest table round-trip, validation, and legacy migration
detail: Covers AC1-AC6 of ticket 9d69e93d: six ref kinds round-trip via write_ref/refs()/set_refs; unknown kind rejected with vocabulary in error; malformed URN rejected per-kind at write time; legacy related_specs bridges to refs() with identical spec identity; foreign/unknown ref kinds already in a manifest round-trip unchanged on read; no edge-model code touched.
